remarks: This session's outbound network could not establish a working TLS connection to any *.rajasthan.gov.in subdomain: rajfab, swcs, labour, rpcb, egazette, bip, invest, and the bare rajasthan.gov.in portal all failed (TLS connection resets, proxy CONNECT-tunnel 502s, or a generic gateway error page instead of real content), despite multiple retries with longer timeouts spread over the session. This looks like a broader, state-agnostic connectivity condition rather than something specific to Rajasthan: the agent proxy's own failure log during this session also showed the same kind of mid-exchange tunnel closures when fetching .gov.in sites for other states entirely unrelated to this task (e.g. Nagaland, Kerala, Jammu & Kashmir, Telangana, Assam, West Bengal single-window/labour sites). As a result, the single most important primary source for this task — RajFAB (https://rajfab.rajasthan.gov.in/), which is Rajasthan's actual online factory registration/license system per the NIC directory listing — could not be directly verified this session; it is only confirmed secondhand via the official NIC (negd.gov.in) directory entry describing it.

Two candidate pages returned HTTP 200 but were React/Next.js single-page-app shells with no server-rendered text retrievable via curl (labour.gov.in and nsws.gov.in/portal/rajasthan). Per the spec these were excluded rather than counted as verified, even though a real browser would likely show relevant content on them.

Given the above, verifiedSources is thinner than ideal for this task (3 entries) — it intentionally favors honesty over padding: every URL listed was personally fetched and its content inspected this session, and every URL that could not be confirmed this way was excluded with a specific reason rather than included on the strength of search snippets or third-party descriptions.
